title: Viva Insights: Agent 365 dashboard for managers in Copilot Analytics
notes: claim 67: severity blocker on a rationale: risk rating lowered to minor; ratings are judgements and cannot hold a page
summary: The briefing needs corrections to its default-state and control descriptions. Microsoft documents default dashboard access for eligible users and a default privacy threshold, while the briefing marks the arrival state as unknown and says protections require configuration. Its web app access note also incorrectly describes the Users route as adding groups.

claims.quote: Managers in organizations can now access their Agent 365 data through the Agent Dashboard in Copilot Analytics (Insights), enabling them to understand activity across all agents registered through Agent 365.

claims.claim: The roadmap says customers with Agent 365 and Copilot will see the Agent 365 Dashboard and historical data.
claims.quote: Customers with Agent 365 and Copilot will now see the Agent 365 Dashboard with the ability to view historical data in Agent Dashboard.
